$comment: The label set for this repository, kept here so it can be reviewed in a diff
rather than remembered. `npm run labels:sync` reports what differs; the same
command with --apply writes it to GitHub.
Three axes and one workflow group. An issue normally carries one type, one
area, and a driver when the report is family-specific.
`from` is a rename: the label already exists under that name and carries
issues, so it is renamed in place rather than replaced, which would drop

type.name: type:bug
type.description: Behaves differently from what it should

type.name: type:feature
type.description: A capability the app should have and does not

type.name: type:driver
type.description: A broker family MQ Studio does not connect to yet

type.name: type:docs
type.description: The README, docs/, or the contributor guides

type.name: type:question
type.description: A usage question rather than a defect

area.name: area:connections
area.description: The connection list, credentials, endpoints, auto-connect

area.name: area:messages
area.description: Query, browse, produce, resend, dead letters

area.name: area:cluster
area.description: Brokers, nodes, runtime metrics, throughput, alerts

area.name: area:ci
area.description: Workflows, checks, and the test environments

workflow.name: needs:info
workflow.description: Waiting on the reporter for something

workflow.name: blocked:upstream
workflow.description: Waiting on a fix in a library or in the broker itself

workflow.name: good first issue
workflow.description: A small, self-contained place to start

workflow.name: help wanted
workflow.description: Needs a cluster or a pair of hands this project does not have

workflow.name: wontfix
workflow.description: Understood, and deliberately not being changed
